1 × DGX Spark, GB10 (128 GB unified memory); BF16

PelaAI's released KnowLine-2B-Gen1 (PelaAI/KnowLine-2B-Gen1 at 53245d4), a merged LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3.5-2B with its readout temperature (T = 1.32) folded into the weights. It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through the card's serve_knowline.sh (SGLang 0.5.21 in BF16 and the repository's knowline_server.py, which reads a request of up to 3,000 tokens twice), with vision on: its vision tower is the base model's, not trained on images. Its card lists English and Chinese.

Latency: the time from sending one request to receiving its answer, measured from our computer, network and any retries within the request included. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept. It is not the run's elapsed time: it leaves out requests that failed and any pause before a run was resumed.
